definition: A fee bundled into the cost of most permanent residence applications, on top of the processing fee. For an application through Express Entry it is included in the $1,590 CAD principal-applicant fee.
longform: It is charged alongside, not instead of, the processing fee, which is why permanent residence applications cost more than a study or work permit application.
